description: This file defines the SugarWidgetField class, which extends the SugarWidget class and provides rendering and utility functions for displaying and managing fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform, including header cells, list values, and labels.

classes.name: SugarWidgetField
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidget that provides methods for rendering field labels, headers, list values, and input widgets in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with the layout manager.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Determines and calls the appropriate display method based on the context attribute.

methods.name: _get_column_alias
methods.description: Generates a column alias name by concatenating table alias and name, then truncating if necessary.

methods.name: displayDetailLabel
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for detail label display.

methods.name: displayDetail
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for detail display.

methods.name: displayHeaderCellPlain
methods.description: Returns the label or translated name for the header cell.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for sortable header cell with sorting arrows and links.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Delegates to displayListPlain for rendering list item.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns the display value for list view; handles checkboxes.

methods.name: _get_list_value
methods.description: Retrieves the list display value for a given field definition.

methods.name: displayEditLabel
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for edit label.

methods.name: displayEdit
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for edit input.

methods.name: displaySearchLabel
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for search label.

methods.name: displaySearch
methods.description: Returns an empty string; placeholder for search input.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Returns a 'not implemented' placeholder for input rendering.

methods.name: getVardef
methods.description: Returns variable definitions for the layout def if available.
